title: HackerSignal
description: A benchmark of 7.45 million deduplicated documents from 64 public forum and source identifiers over a 36-year window (1990–2026). Shared CVE identifiers link hacker community discourse to exploit databases, vulnerability advisories and software fix commits.
cite: Ampel, B. M., & Samtani, S. (2026). HackerSignal: A large-scale multi-source dataset linking hacker community discourse to the CVE vulnerability lifecycle. Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Evaluations & Datasets Track.

title: Cyber Career Pathway Finder
description: A free, plain-language quiz built on the NIST NICE Workforce Framework. It ranks 14 entry-level cybersecurity roles by a student's interests and gives the realistic first job, starter certifications, free practice and US pay for each. Nothing a student answers is stored.
cite: Center for CyberAI Research. (2026). Cyber Career Pathway Finder [Web tool]. Georgia State University. https://bampel.com/ccair/pathways/

title: CCAIR Behavioral Lab
description: Browser-based studies of how people judge cyber threats. Researchers edit study content on an admin page, and the platform handles consent, condition assignment, surveys, behavior traces and data exports.

title: Social engineering stimulus library
description: Placeholder: a curated set of study stimuli (for example phishing emails, vishing audio or deepfake clips) with metadata for reuse. Ben to confirm what will be released.

title: Validated survey instruments
description: Placeholder: measurement scales and questionnaires used in CCAIR behavioral studies, with item wording, scoring and source citations. Ben to confirm which instruments to list.

title: Additional dataset
